subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw accept `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in web_search provider that sends search queries to Firecrawl's hosted keyless tier without credentials?
rationale: The patch follows the established keyless-provider shape and now has positive live proof, but the decision creates a new public provider id and an external hosted search privacy/support boundary that automation should not approve on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Accept the opt-in provider
options.body: Approve `firecrawl-free` as a selectable, never-auto-detected official provider after the branch is refreshed and final checks pass.

options.title: Keep Firecrawl search keyed
options.body: Reject the new keyless provider id but allow the keyed `firecrawl_search` option expansion if maintainers still want the API parity work.

options.title: Defer outside core
options.body: Ask for this hosted keyless search behavior to stay out of OpenClaw core until Firecrawl's no-auth search contract is more stable or a maintainer sponsors it.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in provider
recommendation.body: Approve `firecrawl-free` as a selectable, never-auto-detected official provider after the branch is refreshed and final checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the narrowed merged Firecrawl keyless scrape work and merged the adjacent key-free web-search opt-in policy.
